sourceEditorialReview.notes: All sixteen move explanations, twenty candidate rationales and five proposed contexts read in full. Explanations individually discuss God versus propositions, conditional parity, evolutionary origin versus value, goodness versus obligation, optional universals and qualified convergence. No excluded source or caption corruption grounds a proposed label. Catalog decisions remain proposals for fresh anonymous adjudication, especially where lack of warrant might be mistaken for circularity or ignorance and a conditional ontology question might be mistaken for diversion.
